segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin are one of the largest groups and generally say it absorbs excess oil, especially on the T-zone, and leaves skin feeling less oily without stripping it.
segments.dry: Reports from dry-skin reviewers are mixed: several say it doesn't dry their skin out despite being a clay formula, while others — including two nearly identical reviews — say it does dry the face out a little, and one recommends using it once instead of twice a day to avoid over-drying.
segments.combination: The combination-skin reviewers, some also acne-prone, say it clears breakouts without drying out their skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report it's gentle, low-fragrance and non-irritating, including for eczema-prone skin, though one reviewer specifically warns it can be a drying cleanser for more sensitive skin.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer or smaller breakouts, sometimes within one to two weeks, including reviewers who describe themselves as very acne-prone or hormonal; a consistent minority say they saw no real improvement in their acne, and a couple who tried it as both cleanser and mask say only the spot-treatment use worked for them.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin say the clay absorbs excess oil, particularly around the T-zone and nose, and leaves skin feeling less oily and less congested without stripping it dry.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers, including some with dry skin, say it cleans without stripping or drying their skin; dissent is common too, with several reviewers — including two nearly identical reviews — saying it does dry the face out a little, one recommending only once-daily use to avoid this, and one warning it can be drying specifically for more sensitive skin.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer notes specifically that, unlike some other acne treatments she's tried, it does not disrupt her skin barrier.

I've been using the CeraVe Acne Control Clay to Foam Cleanser for a few weeks now, and I'm seriously impressed! At first, I was curious about how a clay cleanser would foam, but it turns into such a gentle, creamy lather that leaves my skin feeling clean without stripping it dry. The 2% salicylic acid really helps keep breakouts under control, and the kaolin clay is amazing at absorbing excess oil from my T-zone. I also love that it has ceramides and niacinamide, so my skin feels soothed and balanced after every wash. It's perfect for oily and acne-prone skin, but still gentle enough for daily use. My skin feels smoother, less congested, and I've noticed fewer breakouts since adding this to my routine. Definitely a staple for me now! 🙌
